open_points.subject: subfolder escape validation
open_points.text: a connection whose subfolder is written to leave its root is refused
open_points.question: Which written subfolder forms count as leaving the root, and is the decision made before or after normalization, decoding, separator conversion and case handling?
options: Reject any absolute path or lexical parent traversal before normalization
Normalize according to the target filesystem and reject only when the normalized path escapes
Accept only a restricted relative-path grammar
open_points.default_guess: Accept only normalized relative paths whose components contain no parent traversal and whose resolved lexical path remains below the root.

witness.initial: The root is /project and the submitted subfolder is photos/../outside.
events: The owner asks the agent to create the connection.
outcomes: The connection is refused because the written value contains parent traversal.
The connection is accepted because normalization produces /project/outside, which remains under the root.

open_points.subject: linked photo-folder detection
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: What kinds of indirection count as being linked outside the root, and what filesystem identity establishes that the final target is outside?
options: Only symbolic links are followed and checked
Symbolic links, junctions and equivalent filesystem redirects are checked
Any resolved mount, bind mount or redirected ancestor outside the root is rejected
open_points.default_guess: Resolve every path component using the host filesystem and reject any final target or traversed redirect outside the canonical root.

open_points.subject: use-time validation trigger
open_points.question: Which concrete actions constitute use of the photo folder and must perform the outside-root check?
options: Creating or confirming the connection
Scanning in “See what can be delivered”
Reading during “Place chosen photos”
Every access, including scan and placement
open_points.default_guess: Check on every filesystem access, including scanning and placement.

witness.initial: A confirmed connection has a photo-folder link pointing outside its root.
events: The owner asks to see what can be delivered.
The owner then chooses one listed photo to place.
outcomes: The listing request is refused immediately because scanning uses the folder.
The listing succeeds and only placement is refused because placement is treated as the use.

open_points.subject: scope of use-time refusal
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Does detection refuse the whole operation, only the affected folder, only the affected file, or the connection itself?
options: Refuse the entire request
Reject only files reached through that folder
Disable or invalidate the connection
Refuse this access while leaving the confirmed connection unchanged
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the entire request without changing the confirmed connection.

witness.initial: A project has two photo folders; one is inside the root and one links outside it.
events: The owner requests the project's deliverable files.
outcomes: The complete request is refused and no files are returned.
Files from the safe folder are returned while the linked folder is reported as rejected.

open_points.subject: state after outside-root detection
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: After this refusal, does the connection remain confirmed and usable if the link is repaired, or is confirmation revoked or another persistent failure state recorded?
options: Leave the confirmed connection unchanged
Automatically revoke confirmation
Persist a blocked or unavailable state requiring owner action
Record nothing and reevaluate on every use
open_points.default_guess: Leave confirmation unchanged, record no new connection state, and reevaluate on the next use.

witness.initial: A confirmed connection's photo folder currently links outside the root.
events: The owner attempts to use the folder and receives a refusal.
The owner repairs the link without reconnecting.
The owner retries the same operation.
outcomes: The retry succeeds because confirmation remained valid.
The retry is refused until the owner reconfirms because detection invalidated the connection.

open_points.subject: validation timing and filesystem race
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Must the implementation prevent the folder or any ancestor from being retargeted outside the root between validation and file access, and which filesystem operation provides that guarantee?
options: A best-effort path check before access is sufficient
Recheck immediately before each access
Use handle-relative, no-follow operations that bind validation to the accessed object
open_points.default_guess: Use handle-relative filesystem operations that prevent link retargeting from escaping the validated root.

witness.initial: The photo folder points inside the root when validation begins.
events: The calling flow starts placing a chosen photo.
Another local actor retargets the folder link outside the root after the check but before the file is opened.
outcomes: The outside file is read because validation and access are separate.
Access is refused because the opened object is constrained to the root.
witness.observer: The owner and any operator of the outside folder

open_points.subject: non-photo linked folders
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Are links outside the root permitted for the object's other folders, or must the same use-time boundary rule apply to every connected folder?
options: Apply the rule only to the photo folder
Apply the rule to every connected folder
Define separate boundary rules for each folder role
open_points.default_guess: Apply the same outside-root prohibition to every connected folder unless a folder role is explicitly allowed to cross the boundary.

witness.initial: An object has a photo folder inside its root and another connected folder linked outside the root.
events: The calling flow uses the non-photo folder.
outcomes: The access proceeds because the text restricts only the photo folder.
The access is refused because every connected folder is constrained to its root.

open_points.subject: connection success versus delayed refusal
open_points.text: delivery becomes possible for that project; a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Can connecting and confirming a photo folder that already links outside the root report success even though delivery through it will be refused, or must connection fail so that “delivery becomes possible” remains true?
options: Accept and confirm the connection, then refuse its later use
Refuse connection immediately when the existing link resolves outside
Report a confirmed but presently unusable connection
open_points.default_guess: Refuse connection immediately if the outside-root link is detectable at connection time, and also revalidate on later use.

witness.initial: The submitted photo folder already links outside its root.
events: The owner asks the agent to connect and confirm it.
outcomes: The action succeeds with a confirmed record and says delivery is possible, but the first delivery-related use is refused.
The connection action is refused because delivery cannot become possible in the submitted state.

open_points.subject: observable refusal result
open_points.text: a connection whose subfolder is written to leave its root is refused, a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: What observable result identifies each refusal to the owner or calling flow, including whether the two failures have distinct stable reasons?
options: Return one generic invalid-folder failure
Return distinct lexical-escape and resolved-outside-root reasons
Expose only success or refusal without a reason
open_points.default_guess: Return distinct stable failure reasons for lexical escape and resolved outside-root access, without exposing sensitive outside paths.

witness.initial: One request contains a lexical escaping subfolder; another uses a photo-folder link resolving outside the root.
events: The owner submits each request through the agent.
outcomes: Both requests produce the same generic refusal.
Each request produces a distinct actionable refusal reason.
witness.observer: The owner and the calling flow
